Furthermore, the company’s recent operational performance shows alarming volatility, with the quarterly operating margin plummeting to -35% in March 2026, a sharp 18 percentage point decline from the year-ago quarter [E28]. However, these isolated positives do not mitigate the risks posed by the current disconnect between the company's high market valuation and its deteriorating quarterly margins [E3, E6, E28].
